input_law: valid eight-point sums sampled from four exact N41 W6 pair domains with eight distinct folded columns; these are planted structural rows, not ordinary-query yield samples
feature_order: constant; 12 pair-0/1 seed-sum bits; 40 target-x bits 1..40; all squarefree quadratics on those 52 bits in lexicographic order; mixed cubics s0_i*s1_j*x_k for i,j in 0..5 and k in 1..40
rank_gate: Full rank on valid rows certifies no nonzero universal Boolean equality in this feature family. A rank deficit in this finite sample is inconclusive and requires new rows and an independent holdout before proposing a filter.
claim_boundary: Structural multi-target planted-row rank only; no fixed-public-target filter, ordinary relation, one-target DLP, rho pair, or speedup
